prompts.realityAttack1Prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE animation production SPRITE SHEET using attached character as identity and outfit reference. Exactly FOUR frames in an evenly spaced 2x2 grid on genuine transparent alpha background, no opaque or semitransparent backdrop, no labels, text, shadow, VFX or scenery. 1024x1024 square. All four sprites are the SAME adult man, same scale and a fixed elevated 3/4 southeast camera; full head to toe and ENTIRE sword fit within each quadrant with 15% empty margin. Draw one sword attack progressing in reading order: top-left CONTACT pose with sword extended forward toward lower-right, torso and legs braced; top-right FOLLOW THROUGH with torso visibly rotated and sword continuing across; bottom-left RECOVERY bringing right sword arm toward waist while feet settle; bottom-right READY with relaxed bent knees, sword lowered, face still southeast. The sword is in the RIGHT HAND in ALL frames, scabbard on LEFT HIP empty. A single steel sword with straight blade. Both hands anatomically clear, no extra limbs or weapons. Contact happens immediately in game, first frame is contact, do not add a preparatory idle. Preserve face, hair, clothing and gear, redraw complete bodies in natural different poses. No copy-pasted idle bodies. Keep stable foot pivot center of each cell at 85% height. Whole figure should occupy at most 65% cell width so sword and flowing fabric do not overlap cells. Hand-painted 2D RPG rendering matching reference. Modern short-black-haired hunter, charcoal tactical gear and black armored boots, subtle cool blue equipment accents, NO robe or cape.

Hand-painted raster sprite style of reference, consistent anatomy and asymmetrical equipment. Sword scabbard remains empty on left hip.
